captions.jchain_mrr_bars: MRR of the generated answer's best content token in the layer-19 lens-decoded vocab ranking of each variant's predicted answer profile v-hat(C), over 999 fresh-WildChat contexts. Left panel: all variants (the fitted maps set the y-scale). Right panel: the same quantity zoomed to the Jacobian arms. Grey line = mean of 200 shuffled-pairing null draws (re-paired per draw); grey band = null mean to p97.5. m_shipped is the committed round's value + null cited from disk, NOT recomputed here.
captions.jchain_percontext_hist: Per-context log10 rank of the best content token for J_last_affine (true pairing, outline) against every context's shuffled-pairing null rows (filled). Right-shifted true-pairing mass would indicate the transported signal carries the answer's words.
